Negative-origin MediaBox, offset CropBox, CropBox with a quarter turn, CropBox reaching outside the MediaBox, reversed MediaBox corners

startxref points far past the end of the file
The first 62% of a valid file: no cross-reference table or trailer
A %PDF header followed by 2 KB of pseudo-random bytes
A 14400 x 14400 point page (the PDF maximum); rendered at a reduced scale to stay inside the pixel budget
6000 nested q operators before any drawing
36 blended and translucent layers
The 14 standard fonts, not embedded
